In addition to the techniques of integration we have already seen, several other tools are widely available to assist with  the process of integration. Among these tools are integration tables, which are readily available in many books,  including the appendices to this one. Also widely available are computer algebra systems (CAS), which are found on  calculators and in many campus computer labs, and are free online.  Tables of Integrals  Integration tables, if used in the right manner, can be a handy way either to evaluate or check an integral quickly.
